delayPanel.title: Delay compensation
delayPanel.emptyHint: Once a process and its devices are selected, every copied device can be delayed: {{step}} per step, up to ±{{range}} s.
delayPanel.hint: {{step}} per step, up to ±{{range}} s. Positive makes this device play later; negative marks it as the earliest of the group, moving the other copies later instead.
delayPanel.primaryHint: The primary device is played by the OS directly and cannot be delayed. If the lagging device is a Bluetooth one, select it first (it becomes the primary) and compensate the others.

settings.title: Settings
settings.autoRememberDesc: Remember each process's device routing and restore it automatically
settings.delaySyncDesc: Compensate faster devices to align with a slower (Bluetooth) one
settings.delayPrimaryNote: The primary device is played by the OS directly and cannot be delayed; make the lagging (Bluetooth) device a copy target instead. A positive value holds a device back, a negative one marks it as the earliest device of the group (the other copies move later).
settings.delayRangeDesc: Delays can be set within this ± range
settings.delayStepDesc: How much each − / + click changes; an exact value can also be typed
settings.aboutDesc: Per-app audio routing for Windows — Rust talking to Windows Core Audio directly, no third-party executables.
